statement: Repodaki sistemlerin hepsi kusursuz organize bağlanacak ve kusursuz hizmet verecek: güvenli, performanslı, multi-tenant, üretimde olan bir yazılımın endüstriyel şekilde hatasız olması ve üstün kod kalitesi.

threshold_design.why_a_ladder: A bar nobody can measure is a wish. Most of these dimensions are not instrumented today (production deploys have been disabled since 2026-07-15, the WAL-freshness lane has never produced a job, the backup evidence signature is skipped, there is no product-side latency ledger), so the FIRST bar is being able to see, and only then being good.
threshold_design.zero_tolerance_vs_budgeted: Cross-tenant reads and critical vulnerabilities are not budgeted — one occurrence ends the product. Latency and error rates ARE budgeted: bounded imperfection is engineering, pretended perfection is theatre.
threshold_design.ratchet: A stage, once reached, cannot silently regress: falling back below a reached bar is a red night, not a return to the earlier stage.
threshold_design.unknown_is_never_green: A dimension that cannot be read breaks the streak exactly like a failing one.

stages.acceptance: zero dimensions report unknown for 7 consecutive nights
all dimension budgets held for 14 consecutive nights
escaped-defect rate <= 5%, change-failure rate <= 15%, MTTR <= 1h, all B budgets held, for 30 consecutive nights

dimensions.instrument_gap: Contract parity votes inside these lanes but is not reported as its own number; stage B needs the count, not the lane verdict.
dimensions.rationale: Organised connection has an exact measurable form: zero drift between declared and implemented contracts (OpenAPI vs Nest, GraphQL schema vs resolver, event contract vs consumer).

dimensions.instrument_gap: detect_http_5xx_share exists (E24-a) but has never ingested a sample; there is no product-side p99 ledger at all.
dimensions.rationale: Service quality is a rate, not a boolean: bounded failure is engineering, and the bound is what makes it honest.

dimensions.instrument_gap: Dependabot severity counts (131 open today: 1 critical, 42 high) are not read by any ARIA consumer.
dimensions.rationale: Zero critical is not negotiable; a high with an age limit is, because a fleet of dependencies is never momentarily perfect.

dimensions.instrument_gap: The tenant-scoping adapter's 41 findings live in shadow; nothing yet turns them into this count.
dimensions.rationale: This is the one dimension that cannot carry a budget: a single cross-tenant read is not a degraded service, it is a different product.

dimensions.operator_words: üretimde olan bir yazılımın endüstriyel şekilde hatasız olması
dimensions.instrument_gap: A green backup lane proves an upload, not a recovery; no restore has ever been rehearsed, and the evidence-signing job is skipped while DR activation waits on the operator.
dimensions.rationale: Industrial means provably recoverable. The number that matters is the last time a restore actually worked.

dimensions.instrument_gap: Total coverage is reported; changed-line coverage is not, and total coverage flatters a large repository.
dimensions.rationale: Changed-line coverage is the only coverage number that cannot be inflated by untouched code.

outcome_metrics_stage_c.note: Both rates are unmeasurable while production deploys stay disabled (PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_ENABLED=false since 2026-07-15). Stage C cannot begin before that operator decision — the charter says so rather than quietly scoring around it.
